Container.Name: wealth-tracker
Container.Overview: Personal net worth tracker. Tracks monthly snapshots of accounts, savings, investments, and crypto. Data is stored in a SQLite database persisted at the mapped /data path.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Path where the SQLite database (wealth.db) is stored. Use appdata for persistence across updates.

Config.Name: Demo DB Path
Config.Description: Path to the demo SQLite database file inside the container. Defaults to /data/demo.db so it persists alongside the main database.

Config.Name: Trading 212 API Credentials
Config.Description: Trading 212 API Credentials for authentication. Should be base64 encoded key_id:secret.

Config.Name: Bugsnag Server API Key
Config.Description: Bugsnag API key for server-side error monitoring. Leave blank to disable. Only active when NODE_ENV=production.

Config.Name: Bugsnag Browser API Key
Config.Description: Bugsnag API key for browser-side error monitoring. Leave blank to disable. Only active when NODE_ENV=production.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. Match to the owner of your appdata directory. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. Unraid default is 100 (users).
